raw_meta_yaml:
{% set name = "mrjob" %}
{% set version = "0.7.4" %}

package:
  name: {{ name|lower }}
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/{{ name[0] }}/{{ name }}/{{ name }}-{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 2c8d8dc8aa4b354a97de18d0260f551f018693af74af104b3d41daf165eebdd4

build:
  entry_points:
    - mrjob = mrjob.cmd:main
  number: 3
  noarch: python
  script: python -m pip install -vv .

requirements:
  host:
    - python {{ python_min }}
    - pip
  run:
    - python >={{ python_min }}
    - ujson
    - boto3 >=1.4.6
    - botocore >=1.6.0
    - pyyaml >=3.08
    - google-api-python-client >=1.5.0
    - rapidjson

test:
  requires:
    - python {{ python_min }}
  imports:
    - mrjob
    - mrjob.examples
    - mrjob.fs
    - mrjob.logs
    - mrjob.tools
    - mrjob.tools.emr

  commands:
    - mrjob --help

about:
  home: https://github.com/Yelp/mrjob
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  license: Apache 2.0
  license_family: Apache
  summary: Python MapReduce framework
  dev_url: https://github.com/Yelp/mrjob
  doc_url: https://pythonhosted.org/mrjob/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - pmlandwehr
    - mariusvniekerk
